reason: On Ubuntu 24.04.5 x86_64, anonymous registry checks with Skopeo 1.13.3 on 2026-10-10 reproduced the reported tags. `skopeo list-tags --no-creds docker://ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv` listed 92 Python 3.15 tags, all containing python3.15-rc-. `skopeo inspect --no-creds --config docker://ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.15-rc-trixie-slim` returned PYTHON_VERSION=3.15.0rc3 and a uv 0.13.0 image label. Alpine, Trixie, and slim-Trixie configurations confirmed the same Python version on amd64 and arm64. The stable uv slim-Trixie alias and all three corresponding upstream stable Python tags returned manifest unknown. This corroborates the intentional rollback documented in astral-sh/uv#22435; reproduction does not establish that retaining RC tags while upstream stable images are unavailable is incorrect. These were registry metadata checks, without executing containers. Host uv was 0.12.13. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with commands, digests, coverage findings, and limitations; no checkout or GitHub changes were made.
